title: Acid-enhanced ternary DES pretreatment of wheat straw guided by Kamlet–Taft parameters: boosting lignin separation and enzymatic hydrolysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44410-44422
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05909G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jing-yuan Su, Yan-xia An, Lin-lin Li, Jia-zi Wang, Yi Han, Jian Zhang, Yang Zhao
In this study, ternary deep eutectic solvent (DES) systems were constructed by introducing solid acids (AlCl3, PTA, FeBr3) into binary DES systems to achieve improved lignocellulose separation efficiency and enhanced enzymatic hydrolysis.
